rules.title: Boston Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy - Criminal History Restrictions
rules.citation: Boston Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy (February 2017)
rules.quote: The Developer/Agent (Agent) agrees to not consider any of the following categories when determining housing eligibility and or considering eviction: a) Arrests that did not result in conviction. This includes dismissed charges, diversion programs, and similar non-convictions. b) Convictions that are subject to a form of judicial relief, such as expungement, sealing, and certificates for relief from disabilities. c) Juvenile records d) A conviction more than 5 years old.
rules.summary: Housing providers receiving DND funding or with BPDA inclusionary units cannot consider arrests without conviction, expunged or sealed convictions, juvenile records, or convictions more than 5 years old when screening tenants.
rules.coverage_text: housing providers receiving Department of Neighborhood Development (DND) funding and/or land, or that have income restricted units created under the Boston Planning and Development Agency (BPDA) Inclusionary Development Policy
rules.exemption_note: Does not apply where there is a direct relationship between a conviction and the housing sought and or unreasonable risk of substantial harm to the safety of others, or to current criminal behavior. Federal or state law preempts this policy where it conflicts.

rules.title: Boston Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy - Credit Score Prohibition
rules.citation: Boston Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy (February 2017)
rules.quote: The agent agrees not to use the applicant credit score to approve or deny housing applications.
rules.summary: Housing providers covered by the policy cannot use an applicant's credit score to approve or deny housing applications.
rules.coverage_text: housing providers receiving Department of Neighborhood Development (DND) funding and/or land, or that have income restricted units created under the Boston Planning and Development Agency (BPDA) Inclusionary Development Policy
rules.exemption_note: Property Managers may consider credit history (but not credit score) in lieu of rental history to determine ability to pay rent when rental history is not available.
